## Checks

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (drift check, tests, and build).
- [ ] Nothing is sent to another origin, and no analytics, tracking, or cookies are added.
- [ ] No medical text is generated, reworded, or translated at run time. Suggested text cites a public source.
- [ ] Text is never shrunk to fit, and no character renders as a missing glyph.
- [ ] No code branches on a language code.
- [ ] Plain JavaScript. No TypeScript or UI framework.
- [ ] AGENTS.md, README.md, and the other documents still say what the code does.
